subject: CI gating, keystore rotation & rollback evidence for SIG review
messages:
From: Morgan Lee <morgan.lee@aegisassessors.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Acme Bank SOC2 Intake <acmebank.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG request: CI gating evidence + keystore rotation chain-of-custody

Hi Jordan,

We are running the SIG assessment for Acme Bank and need evidence relating to your SDLC controls specifically: CI gating for production deploys, secrets/keystore rotation events, and rollback testing. Can you provide the following artifacts for the July 20 production deployment?

- PR review audit (who approved, timestamps, comment trail)
- CI run logs and run IDs for the gated pipeline that produced the artifact
- Keystore rotation event log showing key IDs, rotation timestamps, and KMS request IDs
- Evidence of a rollback test or runbook execution (screenshots or video acceptable)

We prefer redacted logs with request IDs preserved. If there are timelines/attestations from engineering or security, include those as well.

Thanks,
Morgan
Morgan Lee
Senior Assessor, Aegis Assessors

[Attachment: SIG-questionnaire-v3.pdf]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Morgan Lee <morgan.lee@aegisassessors.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG request: CI gating evidence + keystore rotation chain-of-custody

Hi Morgan —

Thanks for the clear list. Looping in Karthik (CI/infra) and Irene (Security) to assemble the artifacts. We can provide redacted CI logs that preserve run IDs, the PR review export, and the keystore rotation event stream. We will also include the rollback test capture.

Quick notes:
- We will sanitize user emails from the logs but keep the approver IDs and timestamps.
- Keystore rotation events come from our HSM/KMS audit stream and include request IDs; we can provide a JSON export.
- For the rollback proof, we have a recorded run of the rollback playbook executed in a staging replay — we'll attach the MP4 and the run transcript.

Irene/Karthik: can you confirm availability to deliver the artifacts by EOD today? We will also attach a one-paragraph attestation from Security describing retention/sanitization steps.

Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Manager, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

[Internal note: this will be uploaded to the Acme Drive folder and linked to HubSpot case 6789123]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Morgan Lee <morgan.lee@aegisassessors.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG request: CI gating evidence + keystore rotation chain-of-custody

Jordan / Morgan —

I pulled the artifacts and redacted PII as discussed. Items attached and uploaded to the shared Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-example

Attachments included (stubs):
- pr-review-audit-20270720.csv (PR id, author_id, approver_id, timestamps, review comments)
- ci_run_20270720-87421.log (pipeline steps, job IDs, artifact hashes; user ids redacted, request IDs preserved)
- redacted-deploy-trace.txt (deploy tracing with node IDs and request ids)
- keystore-rotation-events-20270720.json (rotation records: old_key_id, new_key_id, kms_request_id, timestamp)
- rotation-rollforward-test-20270720.mp4 (video of rollback playbook execution in staging)

Notes: the keystore rotation was initiated at 2027-07-20T03:42:10Z via our KMS (key create + rotate flow). The rotation event JSON includes the KMS request IDs required for auditor correlation.

If you need any additional log correlation (trace IDs), let me know and I can pull those from the observability retention store.

Thanks,
Karthik
Staff SRE, Redwood Inference

From: Morgan Lee <morgan.lee@aegisassessors.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 13:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG request: CI gating evidence + keystore rotation chain-of-custody

Thanks Karthik — that looks helpful. A few clarification requests before we close this off:

- For the keystore rotation JSON, can you add the KMS API call trace id (if available) and the actor principal (redacted to principal ID) so we can show chain-of-custody?
- For the rollback video, can you provide a one-line annotation of the test objective and the expected vs actual state after rollback?
- We also need an explicit statement that the production deploy was gated by the CI PR checks (i.e., the artifact could not be promoted without MR approvals + passing e2e gates). A brief attestation from security or release engineering is fine.

If you can provide the additional correlation items and the attestation by end of day, we can mark this requirement satisfied for Acme Bank's SIG.

Best,
Morgan

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Morgan Lee <morgan.lee@aegisassessors.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG request: CI gating evidence + keystore rotation chain-of-custody

Morgan —

Attached are the requested supplemental items and the attestation from Security. Summary of deliverables:

- keystore-rotation-events-20270720.json (updated with kms_api_trace_id and principal_id fields; redacted to principal IDs only)
- pr-review-audit-20270720.csv (unchanged)
- ci_run_20270720-87421.log (includes pipeline job ids and artifact SHA)
- rotation-rollforward-test-20270720.mp4 (annotated; table-of-contents in separate text file)
- security-attestation-20270721.txt (signed by Irene Choi, Head of Security)

We uploaded everything to the Drive folder and linked the HubSpot ticket: HubSpot 6789123 — Acme SIG. You should see a readme in the Drive folder describing redaction steps and correlation fields.

Quote of the attestation (excerpt):
"Redwood Inference attests that the July 20, 2027 production promotion was gated by code review approvals and automated gating checks in the CI pipeline. Keys rotated on 2027-07-20 were created and promoted via our KMS with recorded request IDs; the event stream attached contains the API trace IDs required for auditor verification."

Irene will send the signed attestation separately; if you need an HSM export with signed attestations from our KMS provider, we can request that (may take 48–72 hours).

Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Manager, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

[Attachments: security-attestation-20270721.txt, keystore-rotation-events-20270720.json, pr-review-audit-20270720.csv, ci_run_20270720-87421.log, rotation-rollforward-test-20270720.mp4]
